lang_available_desc:
Use `.lang <code>` to set your language, or `.lang server <code>` for server default.

**Supported Languages:**
• 🇺🇸 `en` — English
• 🇧🇷 `pt-BR` — Português (Brasil)
• 🇪🇸 `es` — Español
• 🇫🇷 `fr` — Français
• 🇩🇪 `de` — Deutsch
